title: A Lantern for the Uniform
author: Quentin Winterbourne
blurb: Odile Crane, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
